create_sensed_effector: create a SpyEffector wrapper and ActionSensor from an existing effector to track the last command received
build_spy_effector: build a SpyEffector that caches the previous action command sent to a delegate effector
review_action_sensor_observables: review the ActionSensor observables dictionary to inspect the previous action observation key and Generic observable
test_spy_effector_set_control: test the SpyEffector set_control method to verify it caches the command before forwarding to the delegate
summarize_observations_enum: summarize the Observations enum that defines the PREVIOUS_ACTION observation key format for the ActionSensor
